currentFocus: Preparing the October 27 Soft Alpha: chat, Whispers, moderation, trading, Chat/Social polish and the desktop Play workspace are in; letting characters build their own stashes at their work sites.

currentChange.summary: Site stashes: build a permanent stash mount at The Jag, Rusk Recovery, the Processing Yard or Deep Jag, then install any container you own to keep materials right where you work.

latestCompleted.summary: Desktop Play workspace: at 1280px and wider a right-hand rail keeps Current Missions in view and docks Chat, Inventory, Character and Missions beside the game, with Map in the header.

nextStep: Human playtest of site stashes (#284): build a mount, install each container, swap and remove, on a phone and at desktop width.

highlights.summary: Deep Jag is playable: brace the cave-in for Tansy, mine Galvanite behind it, and refine Galvanic Stock and Galvaferrite at the Processing Yard.
Added Rusk Recovery and 10,000 Hours: Wade's own yard, a workbench that practises Welding indefinitely for scrap, and the Clean Pass moment every weld now rolls.
Added Map MISSION and TURN IN destinations, blue turn-in guidance, compact Mission strips at the top of Play, and visible keyboard focus on beveled controls.
